name: Widget Title
helpText: Header title for the widget.

name: View Mode
helpText: 'monthly' = 12 monthly bars, 'ytd_weekly' = 52 weekly buckets for current year, 'mtd_daily' = daily points for current month, 'daily' = rolling windowDays.

name: Energy Unit
helpText: Unit displayed on the Y-axis and in tooltips.

name: Actual Energy Key (Realtime)
helpText: Realtime kW key used for today's partial generation (agg=SUM today-window). Also used as fallback for the full year if actualDailyEnergyKey is missing.

name: Actual Daily Energy Key (Pre-computed)
helpText: Pre-computed daily kWh key written by daily_job.py at midnight. Primary source for past days. If missing (plant not yet backfilled), widget falls back to actualEnergyKey agg=SUM.

name: P50 Monthly Forecast Key
helpText: Monthly P50 forecast key (MWh). Written by pvalue_job.py. Used in monthly view mode.

name: P90 Monthly Forecast Key
helpText: Monthly P90 forecast key (MWh). Used in monthly view mode.

name: P95 Monthly Forecast Key
helpText: Monthly P95 forecast key (MWh). Outer risk band. Used in monthly view mode.

name: P50 Daily Forecast Key (daily mode)
helpText: Daily P50 forecast key (MWh). Used in daily view mode only.

name: P90 Daily Forecast Key (daily mode)
helpText: Daily P90 forecast key (MWh). Used in daily view mode only.

name: P95 Daily Forecast Key (daily mode)
helpText: Daily P95 forecast key (MWh). Used in daily view mode only.

name: Rolling Window (Days) — daily mode only
helpText: Number of past days shown in daily view mode. Ignored in monthly mode.

name: P50 Annual Energy Attribute
helpText: Annual P50 energy (kWh) SERVER_SCOPE attribute — fallback when daily/monthly telemetry is missing.

name: P90 Annual Energy Attribute
helpText: Annual P90 energy (kWh) SERVER_SCOPE attribute — fallback.

name: P95 Annual Energy Attribute
helpText: Annual P95 energy (kWh) SERVER_SCOPE attribute — fallback.

name: Physics Expected Energy Key (pvlib)
helpText: Daily expected energy (kWh) from pvlib daily rollup. Shown as green dotted line. Leave blank to hide.

name: Baseline Daily Energy (kWh) — simulation fallback
helpText: Fallback daily energy kWh used only in pure simulation mode.

name: Decimal Places
helpText: Number of decimal places for tooltip and Y-axis values.

name: Show Confidence Band
helpText: Toggle the shaded risk band between P50 and P90 on the chart.

name: Accent Color
helpText: Override the card border glow accent (CSS color). Leave blank for default cyan.

name: Tooltip Text
helpText: Static tooltip override. Leave blank for auto-generated risk summary.
